Premises:
1. There are some student-athletes who play Division 1 football at Yale who don't exercise every day.
2. All student-athletes who play Division 1 football at Yale are enrolled at the university.
3. All student-athletes who are enrolled at Yale University have a GPA above 1.0.
4. All student-athletes who have a GPA above 1.0 are allowed to take seminar courses.
5. James is a student-athlete who is not allowed to take seminar courses.

Conclusion: If James does not exercise every day and plays Division 1 football at Yale, then he plays Division 1 football at Yale.

entailment.instructions: Does the conclusion logically follow from the premises?

criteria.True: The conclusion follows from the premises
criteria.Unknown: The premises neither entail nor contradict the conclusion
